MSM8996 Sony GFX clock child of native MMCC

This child separates GFX clock registration from the base MMCC clocks used by
CPR. It shares the parent's regmap and must not have its own reg property or
independently map MMCC registers. Native MMCC remains the single clock/GDSC
register owner.

Required parent: qcom,mmcc-msm8996.
Required child properties:
- compatible: qcom,msm8996-v3.0-gfxcc or qcom,msm8996-v3.1-gfxcc, matching SoC.
- #clock-cells: 1.
- vdd-gfx-supply: the real MSM8996 MMSS CPR corner regulator.
- vdd-mx-supply: the real RPM MX logical-corner provider. Native RPM microvolt
  regulators do not implement the required corn/vfc, active/sleep semantics.
- nvmem-cells / nvmem-cell-names: the GPU speed-bin cell, named "speed-bin".
  Sony MSM8996 uses bits 29..31 of the word at physical address 0x74130.
- qcom,gfxfreq-speedbin0 through qcom,gfxfreq-speedbin3: original Sony triples
  <frequency-Hz GFX-corner MX-corner>. The first row is <0 0 0>. Subsequent rows
  have strictly increasing frequencies and supported positive corner indices.
  Reserved fuse bins fail rather than falling back to the fastest bin zero.
- qcom,rpm: the native Qualcomm RPM rpmsg supplier, mandatory for v3.1's original
  MinSVS notification (misc clock resource 3, STAT key). No no-op RPM backend.

Clock indices retain qcom,mmcc-msm8996.h definitions for this five-clock subset:
GFX3D_CLK_SRC, GPU_GX_GFX3D_CLK, GPU_GX_RBBMTIMER_CLK, GPU_AHB_CLK,
GPU_AON_ISENSE_CLK. They are removed from the parent when this child is present,
including when the child is disabled. Thus disabling the regulated child cannot
publish an unregulated parent fallback. Base MMCC still supplies CPR bus clocks.

Retained source-data properties:
- qcom,gfxfreq-mx-speedbin0 through qcom,gfxfreq-mx-speedbin3: original independent
  gpu_mx_clk <frequency-Hz MX-corner> plans. The independent MX vote clock and
  KGSL GX/CX sequencing still need a coordinated port; these properties do not
  imply that the five-clock child implements that separate clock.

Dora source variants keep the child, MMSS CPR, mem-acc, physical S2 buck and RPM
corner resources disabled until the complete voltage, power and KGSL/SMMU chain
is validated. Enabling this node alone is unsupported and is rejected by the
board's automatic source-data/safety checks. F8131/F8132 and panel identity must
not be inferred from a SoC/PMIC tuple.
